channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Healthcare crisis escalating in Yemen’s besieged Taiz
item.description: Fighting between Yemen’s Houthis and the internationally recognised government is deepening the humanitarian crisis.

item.title: Oregon school shooter was former special needs student, police say
item.description: A teacher fought teenage shooter and a parent shot him dead, police say on Friday, a day after four people were killed.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC says supertanker hit naval mine in Hormuz, catches fire
item.description: Iran’s IRGC says an oil supertanker is on fire in the Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine.

item.title: Families demand justice after Pakistan school collapse
item.description: Parents are demanding accountability after a school roof collapse in Pakistan's Peshawar killed 34 children.

item.title: Yemen’s government says Houthis fired two missiles at Aden airport
item.description: Attack comes as Yemeni gov't forces claim advances in Marib and say they 'neutralised' 430 Houthi fighters in 24 hours.

item.title: How Iran messaging highlights cost of war ahead of US midterm elections
item.description: Through statements in English, Iranian officials are emphasising gas prices and issues with the US economy.

item.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
item.description: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.

item.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
item.description: The BBC sees masked settlers attack Palestinians trying to harvest olives, amid a surge in similar incidents.

item.title: Albanian protests turn violent: What we know
item.description: Albania's capital Tirana has seen months of protests from an anti-government "Flamingo" movement, but what started on Tuesday this week was on a different scale.

item.title: China tells Israel to stop 'forced establishment' of West Bank settlements
item.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi spoke to Israeli President Isaac Herzog on the sidelines of a conference.
